# Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication

> Arizona State University's nationally ranked journalism school offering undergraduate and graduate programs in journalism, mass communication, and digital media with hands-on learning experiences.

The Cronkite School is home to award-winning student newsrooms including Cronkite News and the Howard Center for Investigative Journalism, as well as the National Center on Disability and Journalism (NCDJ). Located in downtown Phoenix, the school emphasizes immersive, professional-level journalism training.
